WCAG 2.2 Level AA • ADA Title II • Revised Section 508

Accessibility & Compliance Center

State agencies, public universities, healthcare systems, and federal contractors require an Accessibility Conformance Report (VPAT 2.5) covering the entire software lifecycle—including the Windows installer. RaggieSoft Installer Studio is the first native Win32 C++20 packaging suite engineered for screen-reader, keyboard, and High Contrast compliance from frame one.

Concrete Win32 Assistive Technology & UI Proof

Screen-Reader Live Progress (NVDA, JAWS & Narrator)

Uses native Win32 Common Controls v6 (BUTTON, EDIT, MSFTEDIT_CLASS, PROGRESS_CLASSW) and fires NotifyWinEvent(EVENT_OBJECT_NAMECHANGE) on step transitions while driving real-time progress via MsiSetExternalUIRecord.

100% Keyboard Tab Order & Enforced Mnemonics

Clears UISF_HIDEFOCUS and UISF_HIDEACCEL immediately on WM_CREATE so focus rings and Alt access-key underlines are always visible—backed by static instbuild --validate checks flagging any missing & mnemonic.

Windows Contrast Themes & Per-Monitor V2 DPI

Honors SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST using system GetSysColor tokens, scales crisply from 100% to 300%+ DPI, and multiplies typography by Windows 11's TextScaleFactor accessibility slider.
